components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid brand pill for the main action (Post, New post).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #b83266; color: #fff; font: 700 1rem Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b83266; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: Wash-tinted pill for secondary actions such as Follow.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fde4ec; color: #b83266; font: 700 1rem Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { filter: brightness(.95); } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b83266; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: White pill with a mauve line border for neutral actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #8c7f92; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #2b2330; font: 700 1rem Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #fbe9ee; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b83266; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 16px-corner field with a mauve border and brand focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #8c7f92; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #2b2330; font: 400 1rem Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: #b83266; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b5f70; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b83266; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Feed Pill Tabs
components.description: Friends / Everyone pill tabs on a white track.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid #8c7f92; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #6b5f70; font: 700 1rem Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #fbe9ee; color: #2b2330; } .ds-tab-on, .ds-tab-on:hover { background: #b83266; color: #fff; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b83266; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Pill navigation item; active uses wash with brand text.
components.html: Feed
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; color: #2b2330; font: 700 1.125rem Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #fbe9ee; } .ds-nav-on, .ds-nav-on:hover { background: #fde4ec; color: #b83266; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b83266; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Post Card
components.description: The core unit: white 24px card with round avatar, text and actions.
components.html:
MK
Maya K.@maya2h

Made the soup. It is a good soup.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #f0dde3; border-radius: 24px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(60 30 70 / .06), 0 8px 24px rgb(60 30 70 / .07); color: #2b2330; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-avatar { display: inline-flex; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #b83266; color: #fff; font: 700 1.2rem Gabarito, Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-handle, .ds-age { color: #6b5f70; font-size: .875rem; } .ds-age { margin-left: auto; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-text { margin: 4px 0 0; } .ds-actions { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin: 8px 0 0 -12px; } .ds-act { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #6b5f70; font: 700 .875rem Nunito, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-act:hover { background: #fbe9ee; color: #2b2330; } .ds-liked { color: #ff7a6b; } .ds-act:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b83266; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: The Group Chat You Want to Open
narrative.overview:
be2gether looks like a warm group chat given a feed: rosy-white ground, white cards that float on a soft shadow, round faces, pill buttons and pill tabs, and sentence-case friendly type. Everything is rounded and nothing is hard. Ink is aubergine rather than black, so even text feels tinted and gentle. One cheerful brand colour carries selection and action; a second, coral "pop" colour is rationed to hearts and unread marks so those small signals stay noticeable.

Density is relaxed and phone-first. Cards breathe, tap targets are at least 44px, and the feed is one calm centre column. Dark mode is aubergine night, not black. The person picks the theme: five colour themes swap only brand and pop (and their wash), leaving every neutral untouched, so the system reads the same in all of them.

The build rejects the hard, uppercase, ink-bordered transit-sign look of the first redesign and the cold default social feed. Nothing in the visual system advertises popularity: counts are quiet, tabular, and optional.
keyCharacteristics: Rosy-white paper with white soft-shadowed cards, never cream, never black.
Pills for every control; 24px corners for every card and sheet.
One brand colour, one pop colour, a tinted wash for selection.
Gabarito for titles and the wordmark, Nunito for everything else.
Dark mode is aubergine night; themes swap only brand, pop and wash.

rules.name: The Rationed Pop Rule
rules.body: Pop appears only on liked hearts, unread marks and the wordmark's second bubble. It is never a button, banner or decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Swap Rule
rules.body: A theme changes brand, pop and wash and nothing else. Neutrals, radii, type and shadow are identical across themes.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, tabs and buttons are sentence case. No all-caps, no letter-spaced small caps.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: There is a single soft shadow. No hard offset shadows, no glow, no second tier.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Anything you tap is a pill or a circle. Anything you read in is a 24px card.

dos: Do keep action and selection on the brand colour and selection ground on wash.
Do give every card 24px corners, a blush hairline and the single soft shadow.
Do make every tappable control a pill or circle with at least 44px height.
Do keep dark mode aubergine (`#1d171f` ground), and let themes change only brand, pop and wash.
Do write labels in sentence case and keep counts tabular and optional.
Do switch off the rise and heart-pop animations when Animations is off or reduced motion is set.
donts: Don't use the hard, uppercase, ink-bordered transit-sign look of the first redesign.
Don't use pop for anything beyond hearts, unread marks and the wordmark bubble.
Don't use cream, pure black, or pure grey grounds.
Don't add hard offset shadows or a second shadow tier.
Don't show or imply friend counts or popularity as status.
Don't ship photographs in demo content; photos are user-uploaded only.
